## Discrepancy note
- Wikipedia's founding-29 list includes **Zambia**; The Diplomat's list (source 103) omits it. The gov.cn article (113) names only five signatory examples and does not enumerate all 29. The draft should cite the 29-country count (authoritative, per 113) and treat the exact roster / 37-member total as secondary-sourced.
